model.precisionNote: Stored BF16 coefficients are unchanged. FP32 arithmetic is not asserted identical to BF16 execution.

semantics.encode: RGB [-1,1] to raw posterior mean; no sampling or latent normalization.
semantics.decode: Independent raw latent input through original Hike conv2 and decoder body; raw RGB output without clipping.
semantics.temporal: Native core consumes 1 + 4*floor((sourceFrames-1)/4) source frames and emits 1 + floor((sourceFrames-1)/4) latent steps; incomplete trailing groups are unused. Decoder emits one RGB frame initially and four per continuation.
semantics.spatial: Symbolic spatial axes; no spatial tiling or altered attention boundaries.

lowering.operation: nearest-exact 2x -> ONNX Resize nearest half_pixel round_prefer_floor

validation.status: exported; native-reference and browser validation required

comparisonGate.scope: FP32 reference; acceptance must be recorded separately
